body: my cab entry says the sprayer trial workers brushed off waxy pollen. the driver grew dizzy before the shelter message aired.
title: cab note — at tuesday dawn
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the waxy pollen while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: The overturned list
body: A folded page inside the cab has the names of people assigned seats. Somebody crossed the whole column through and wrote “returned” above it. I saw the truck leave full. No one at the next road would say where its passengers had gone.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
